name: Two MegaMen a side: the leads wait for their partners
result: BN6's link battle closes its Custom screen once both GBAs' packets (bn6f sub_800B3A2, 0x0800B3A2: the mark 0x56789123, the hand, the NaviStats, the Cross's record) have come over the cable, checked each frame of mode 0x14 at 0x08026DEC; holding a side's packet back until its partner's picks are in makes both GBAs wait by BN6's own cable (the other shows BN6's Cstmzing... over the held side). A partner 10 s slow each turn: 3,035 iterations 0 apart, 91 hashes the same with 482 rollbacks and with none, arenaroll=8 683 of 683; a partner who never picks is ended by his client's send at 3,480 frames held, a client gone quiet by the pair's own limit at 3,600 (216 hashes the same with and without rollbacks). The normal NetBattle unchanged (frame 2690, 86d2f837337a1494).
meaning: A partner can be waited for without any clock: the hold is read in the side's GBA's RAM and crosses by BN6's own link, so every client and spectator agrees on the moment the screen closes.
